prompts.name: slender
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game ITEM ICON / replaceable held-weapon sprite. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use the SAME simplified Chinese ink-painted aesthetic as the character's robes and hair: strong black ink contour, deliberate angular flat shadow masses, 3-4 broad matte tonal planes, a few dry brush accents, restrained muted ivory grey and charcoal with a small desaturated celadon/aged bronze accent on the hilt. NOT photoreal metal, not fine watercolor grain, not engraved ornamental museum sword, not shiny chrome, not CG. A complete Chinese double-edged straight JIAN sword alone. Orthographic FLAT SIDE VIEW, exactly HORIZONTAL, pointed tip to LEFT, grip/pommel to RIGHT; no foreshortening, no 3D tilt. Long WIDE transparent canvas, approximately2048x768. Entire sword fromx100 to1940, center axisy384. Blade fromx100 to1570, simple restrained crossguard centered nearx1580, wrap grip fromx1650 tox1860 with gripping center(1760,384), compact pommel tox1940. Keep generous transparent margins all around, no cropping. A bare blade, no scabbard. The steel should be conveyed by a bold dark ink side plane and broad muted grey/ivory blade face, one light edge, not reflected scenery or dense speckles. Hilt has simple ink-black cloth wraps with only 4-5 broad bands; small subdued bronze guard, no jewels, no tassel or dangling pieces. Its silhouette and planes MUST read clearly when reduced to an in-game item or held weapon. Absolutely no character, hands, text, labels, interface, pedestal, floor, drop shadow, particles, aura, bloom, runes, checkerboard, paper background or painted background texture. True alpha transparency outside the silhouette. FORM: SLENDER straight jian. Narrow elegant long blade with slight taper and a pointed tip; blade width about80 units on2048-long frame. Simple modest shallow curved Chinese guard. Spare decoration. Visually slender, crisp and agile without being a rapier or needle.
